step1_figure.description: The netlist describes a full CMOS transmission gate (NMOS and PMOS in parallel). The provided text discusses the NMOS pass gate (Fig 10.13) and PMOS pass gate (Fig 10.15) individually, highlighting their respective weaknesses in passing logic 1 and logic 0, which motivates this parallel combination.

effective_switching_resistance_nmos.description: Effective resistance of the NMOS switch when passing a signal.

equation.explanation: Estimates the average resistance of the NMOS transistor during switching by taking the reciprocal slope of the IV curve.
equation.assumptions: Assumes long-channel square-law behavior and a full VDD gate drive.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 typical parameters for VDD=1.8V, Vth=0.42V, and un*Cox=270uA/V^2.

effective_switching_resistance_pmos.description: Effective resistance of the PMOS switch when passing a signal.

equation.explanation: Estimates the average resistance of the PMOS transistor during switching.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 typical parameters for VDD=1.8V, |Vth|=0.42V, and up*Cox=50uA/V^2.

nmos_pass_gate_voh.description: Maximum output voltage when passing a logic 1 through an NMOS-only pass gate.

equation.explanation: The NMOS transistor cuts off when its source (output) reaches VDD - VTHN, preventing it from passing a full VDD.
equation.assumptions: Assumes input is VDD and gate is VDD. Body effect is ignored in this simple equation but would lower Vout further.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct subtraction of nominal Vth from VDD. Note: The full CMOS TG in the netlist will reach 1.8V because the PMOS pulls it the rest of the way.

pmos_pass_gate_vol.description: Minimum output voltage when passing a logic 0 through a PMOS-only pass gate.

equation.explanation: The PMOS transistor cuts off when its source (output) drops to |VTHP|, preventing it from passing a full ground.
equation.assumptions: Assumes input is 0V and gate is 0V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly equal to the nominal PMOS threshold voltage. Note: The full CMOS TG in the netlist will reach 0V because the NMOS pulls it the rest of the way.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delays, rise/fall times, and voltage swings of the CMOS transmission gate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Transmission Gate Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=1 L_xm1=1 W_xm2=1 L_xm2=1

* DUT
xm1 Vin VDD Vout 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
C1 Vout 0 5e-14
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm2 Vout 0 Vin VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}

* Stimulus
V1 Vin 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 10p 10p 5n 10n)

.control
tran 10p 15n

* Measure propagation delays (50% to 50%)
meas tran t_plh trig v(vin) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(vout) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_phl trig v(vin) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(vout) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure rise and fall times (10% to 90%)
meas tran t_lh trig v(vout) val=0.18 rise=1 targ v(vout) val=1.62 rise=1
meas tran t_hl trig v(vout) val=1.62 fall=1 targ v(vout) val=0.18 fall=1

* Measure voltage extremes to verify full swing (CMOS TG passes full 0 and 1)
meas tran v_max max v(vout)
meas tran v_min min v(vout)

quit
.endc
.end
